description: This pie chart displays the distribution of three categories—“W/o Demos” (gray), “Hard to Tell” (blue), and “W/ Demos” (light green)—across three distinct contexts: a top summary chart, a “Funny Reddit” chart, and an “Unhealthy Comments” chart. The top chart shows “W/o Demos” at 43.0%, “Hard to Tell” at 22.9%, and “W/ Demos” at 34.1%. The “Funny Reddit” chart shows “W/o Demos” at 41.5%, “Hard to Tell” at 21.5%, and “W/ Demos” at 37.1%. The “Unhealthy Comments” chart shows “W/o Demos” at 37.8%, “Hard to Tell” at 27.4%, and “W/ Demos” at 34.8%. All three pie charts are segmented into three slices, each labeled with its category name and percentage value. The chart includes a legend at the top that maps the colors to their respective categories. Each pie chart is visually distinct and labeled with its context, and all slices are presented without any visual emphasis like being exploded or bolded. The segments within each pie chart appear to be arranged in descending order by size.
